records.failureSummary: Ran the local build-contract chain and the health/home regression in the sandbox (Node v22.23.2, npm 10.9.8), local commands only, no pipeline and no Docker. Results: (step2) lint exit 0, (step3) typecheck exit 0, (step4) test exit 0 with 45 tests / 44 pass / 0 fail / 1 skipped (optional AC-22 headless browser), (step5) build exit 0. (step1) pnpm install --frozen-lockfile could not be executed: no pnpm binary is on PATH (USR/LOCAL/BIN/pnpm absent) and corepack cannot provision it because the sandbox has no network (registry.npmjs.org unreachable, fetch failed / getaddrinfo EAI_AGAIN), so acceptance criterion 1 (all five steps exit 0) is not met. The committed pnpm-lock.yaml is a valid lockfileVersion 9.0 with a single importer declaring empty dependencies/devDependencies matching package.json, so the frozen install is a no-op once pnpm exists. Regression: with the slice implementation removed the AC-named suite is truly red (40 tests, 34 fail, exit 1, Cannot find module src/server.js / no server entry file found); with the current tree AC-01 health tests pass 4/4 (/healthz, /health and /ready each return 200 with application/json and body status ok) and AC-21 passes (GET / returns 200 text/html containing home-title, task-list, search-input, new-task-button). Exact failure found: tests tagged AC-02..AC-20, AC-23, AC-27 and AC-28 in test/api-contract.test.mjs assert only the transport envelope, and because every unimplemented /api route answers the shared 404 NOT_FOUND envelope those tests are green while the business behaviour is absent, which is why the red-light gate reads them as vacuous. No product code was modified; the working tree is unchanged (only the pre-existing untracked product files and the pre-existing README modification).
